_note: Flywheel loop/route binding table (DESIGN.md §13 法定配置, v0.22 三厂商定稿). Bindings live here, never in skills. All models run max thinking tier (§7): zcode via session/create thoughtLevel=max (app-server protocol); Codex via -c model_reasoning_effort=max (GPT-6-Astra defaults to medium — must be explicit); kimi CLI via per-invocation env KIMI_MODEL_THINKING_EFFORT=max (never touches the user's global config). drivers values are mock|real ONLY (harness selection lives in the loops/routes bindings below, never here). v0.19: NO fallback providers — every role runs on exactly one subscription channel; QUOTA/RATE_LIMIT degrades to same-channel backoff retries (RATE_LIMIT) or direct inbox escalation (QUOTA).

judge._note: milestone final verification primary, FRESH context each call (headless -p spawns never resume); kimi -p enforces auto permission by default (explicit --auto conflicts with --prompt)

intake._note: triage advice only, near-zero cost (§4.5, §13); flash tier via zcode app-server (per-session model, coexists with default route)

default._note: v0.22: flagship for volume execution (quality-first principle); zcode app-server driver (per-session model + thoughtLevel)

multimodal._note: v0.22: the ONLY multimodal tier in zcode's catalog (image/PDF/video input, 1M context) — packets carrying screenshots/design assets tag route=multimodal

hard._note: escalation route after repeated GLM-5.3 failures; stays K3 because GPT-6-Astra already serves Review — hard units must keep a cross-vendor reviewer (§4.2)

judge-panel._note: v0.18 A3 dual-judge panel (TOP-LEVEL key, sibling of loops): second opinion on the milestone final verification — judge primary runs kimi code + K3 (loops.judge), panel secondary is GPT-6-Astra cross-vendor; agreement decides, split escalates to inbox (DESIGN §4.3). Delete this key to disable the panel.

zai-coding-plan._note: Z.AI Coding Plan subscription, the main GLM channel since v0.22 (zcode app-server driver; credentials live user-side in ~/.zcode/cli/config.json — orchestrator injects NO key). Model slugs use zcode's own zai/ namespace. Undocumented protocol: handshake failures fail loud, never silently degrade (DESIGN §10-5 drift tracking).

chatgpt-subscription._note: ChatGPT subscription OAuth (codex login), user-side, no key injected; serves Review + judge panel (GPT-6-Astra). Version gate: gpt-6-astra needs codex CLI >=0.154 (npm) or >=0.153 (app-bundled binary) — older builds 400.

kimi-subscription._note: kimi code CLI subscription login (device-code OAuth), no API key injected; Plan/Garden/Judge-primary/frontend/hard all ride it

zhipu-coding-plan._note: B-CHANNEL since v0.22 (domestic bigmodel GLM Coding Plan via omp, credentials in omp provider config): emergency fallback when the zcode app-server protocol drifts after a desktop update, or multimodal transition. Not bound to any main-path role.

_note_pricing: USD per 1M tokens, fallback when the driver reports no cost. All main-path channels are subscriptions — pricing placeholders are zeros; backfill per-provider only if a metered channel is ever added.
